project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used. The `sample_rule` block supports: * `conversation_filter` - (Optional) To specify the filter for the conversions that should apply this sample rule. An empty filter means this sample rule applies to all conversations. * `dimension` - (Optional) Group by dimension to sample the conversation. If no dimension is provided, the sampling will be applied to the project level. Current supported dimensions is 'quality_metadata.agent_info.agent_id'. * `sample_percentage` - (Optional) Percentage of conversations that we should sample based on the dimension between [0, 100]. * `sample_row` - (Optional) Number of the conversations that we should sample based on the dimension. The `schedule_info` block supports: * `end_time` - (Optional) End time of the schedule. If not specified, will keep scheduling new pipelines for execution until the schedule is no longer active or deleted. A timestamp in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format, with nanosecond resolution and up to nine fractional digits. Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z". * `schedule` - (Optional) The groc expression. Format: `every number [synchronized]` Cron syntax is not supported. Time units can be: minutes, hours Synchronized is optional and indicates that the schedule should be synchronized to the start of the interval: every 5 minutes synchronized means 00:00, 00:05 ... Otherwise the start time is random within the interval. Example: `every 5 minutes` could be 00:02, 00:07, 00:12, ... * `start_time` - (Optional) Start time of the schedule. If not specified, will start as soon as the schedule is created. A timestamp in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format, with nanosecond resolution and up to nine fractional digits. Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z". * `time_zone` - (Optional) The timezone to use for the groc expression. If not specified, defaults to UTC.
